decisions.decision: Loaded Vibes is optimized for developer time saved and the usefulness of the generated repository, not governance breadth.
CLI, web configurator, and loadedvibes.json share one configuration schema and normalization path.

Loaded Vibes is the sole executable application-template authority and DevNotes is the Hipster Stack doctrine authority. DigitalHerencia/Vibes is not an upstream, reference, sync, provenance, packaging, or runtime dependency.
The final repository contains one maximal white-label application at template/. Generation copies that source, resolves ownership, removes excluded material, and applies structured transforms.

packages/recipes and duplicated templates/modules source are migration-era structures. Useful defaults and ownership semantics may be preserved, but the structures themselves are not the target architecture.
Presets, when retained, are convenience defaults over one configuration model and never represent separate templates or architectures.
A configuration option is user-selectable only when Loaded Vibes can make a real deterministic change to generated output or project lifecycle.
Loaded Vibes' website is a dark developer tool with separate landing, configure, and docs surfaces. The CLI remains the primary execution surface and the web configurator remains stateless.
Root docs/ is the canonical end-user documentation source. context/ remains maintainer/Codex context.
The migration adds no new tests or validation systems. Existing relevant checks may be run proportionally for the behavior changed by an Issue.
